sourceVerification.existingSeven: All seven live SHA256 identical to saved official snapshot metadata. No supplier endpoint called.
sourceVerification.discovery: Followed official index -> framework/scripts/helpcenter/interface.js -> exact data-url -> linked return models. One initial task-call document timeout succeeded on retry.

manual.timeUnit: epoch seconds: query explicit, response examples
manual.queue: qnos request is outbound group; no qno response in saved table

predictive.timeUnit: epoch seconds: query explicit, response examples
predictive.queue: qno: table says queue, query qnos says outbound group; never assume local skill identity

durations.firstQueueDuration: first queue only; seconds based onexample

flows.firstCallCno: first called agent, not necessarily final answered agent

inbound.statuses: Chinese strings 人工接听/人工未接听/系统应答/系统未应答; request uses different numeric statuses enum

durations.intelligentBridgeDuration: robot conversation seconds, independent from human transfer

auto.scope: Official task-call source; query supports taskIds. Presence of cno alone is not human-answer proof.

inboundAgentLeg.identity: uniqueId is leg identity; mainUniqueId parent conversation
inboundAgentLeg.scope: Confirmed separate supplier source for actual per-agent/per-queue legs; do not count every leg as one new global conversation.

cumulativeTask.timeScope: cumulative by task; no time filters documented

daily.warning: Do not add totalStatistic to list; do not sum distinct counts or arithmetic-average percentages across rows.

agent.source: 获取预测外呼座席报表

ownership.qname: queue display label only; no qno in return model
ownership.task: task name only; no taskId in return model

units.stateIdle/statePause/stateInuse/stateCal: state durations HH:mm:ss examples, distinct from CDR conversation seconds

queue.knownConflict: StatisticQueueHour text describes telEnterCount as answered and telAnswerCount as entered, while examples and labels indicate reverse. Preserve raw until correction; do not silently reassign or derive corresponding ratios.

dedupRules: Filter enterprise and authorized tenants before joins/grouping; never disclose out-of-scope lead sources.
Call totals count provider conversation once using enterpriseId+mainUniqueId; keep source/row identity for unmatched records and surface missing/conflicting keys instead of collapsing them.

Agent/queue legs deduplicate enterpriseId+uniqueId and join parent mainUniqueId. Leg participation may legitimately exceed unique conversation counts. Do not sum those participation counts for brand call totals.
API319 cnoFlow/qnoFlow do not establish one-to-one positional pairing, answered ownership, or leg durations. Use new /cc/list_cdr_ib_agent evidence for those fields.
A skill group is a local authorization grouping, outbound gno and queue qno are distinct supplier concepts. Use explicit mappings; names or current membership are not historical attribution.
Provider summary statistics are a separate grain. Do not mix task-cumulative rows, date summaries, totalStatistic, CDR calls and legs in one sum.

Latest known complete raw CDR must not be overwritten by a duplicate partial unknown receipt without reconciliation; same conversation moving tenants requires ownership validation rather than duplicate counting.

brandAndLead.userDecision: Within one brand, merge leads by exact lead code. This does not change phone-based customer-archive identity.
runtimeEvidence: mock/data.js:35-37 multiple tenants share same supplier account
js/app.js:397 brand chooser uses enterpriseId with brandCustomerName label
brandAndLead.existingStructure: Current fixtures use instance enterpriseId as brand-context selection, with brandCustomerName display text. No independent authoritative cross-account brand map exists in base fixtures.
brandAndLead.safeFallback: Explicit stable brand identity when available; otherwise current enterprise context. Display names cannot authorize cross-enterprise merging.
brandAndLead.identity: Only businessType=lead uses code. Preserve String formatting/leading zeros. Empty/invalid codes remain unidentified; do not collapse all blanks or numeric coerced values.
brandAndLead.aggregation: One lead can have multiple batches, stores, numbers and calls in authorized scope. Union call identity for lead total. Include both overall distinct lead count and visible source rows for explanation.

acceptancePlan.case: same epoch value API317/API318 maps different answered party; no rate or talk mixup
system answer only inbound remains customer/system answered, not human answered
one parent with 2 agents/2 queues: total call1, participating rows2, segment duration exact
null flow arrays and unknown durations remain unknown; explicit0 remains0
automatic no-human CDR counted through auto_task, human metrics not fabricated
task official total6/calls>completed/retry1 remain distinct and new task no fixture unknown
same brand exact lead code across HQ/store/batches merges one with combined source rows
different brand same code,0012vs12,nonlead same code,missingcode do not improperly merge
store-only viewer has no HQ source row or counts; context switch invalidates old drawer/export

limits: No real supplier authentication, network calls to API hosts, or production data tested.
Official report query permissions cannot replace platform tenant attribution. Shared queue/outbound group aggregate cannot safely be split by local tenant without explicit ownership.
Queue telEnterCount/telAnswerCount conflict needs supplier correction if those fields are exposed with translated labels.
Agent report only returns qname/task names, so it cannot independently verify numeric queue/task identity from each row. Preserve original request scope and avoid name-based mapping.
